name: plotleaf
description: Beautiful, interactive reports from Markdown and JSON. Built for agents.

scripts.format: bun fmt src scripts tests playwright.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.browser.json tsconfig.dev.json bunfig.toml .github/workflows/ci.yml
scripts.typecheck: bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.dev.json
scripts.typecheck:tsrs: bun node_modules/tsrs/bin/tsrs --noEmit --fast false -p tsconfig.json && bun node_modules/tsrs/bin/tsrs --noEmit --fast false -p tsconfig.browser.json && bun node_modules/tsrs/bin/tsrs --noEmit --fast false -p tsconfig.dev.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run test:consumer
scripts.dev: bun run build && node dist/cli.js dev examples/report.md
